# Play Store Release Notes

  Each file in this directory is a locale-specific release note sent to Google Play.

  File naming: `<language>-<region>.txt` (e.g. `en-US.txt`, `fr-FR.txt`).

  The file is picked up automatically by the **Upload to Google Play** step
  in `.github/workflows/build-apk.yml` on every release build.

  Edit the file before merging a release branch to give testers a useful changelog.
